name: task-graph
description: The decomposed task plan as a graph: a DAG of steps carrying status, acceptance criteria and evidence, persisted beside the task tracker in the project's tracking.db and served over MCP stdio from a PEP 723 `uv run --script` launch.

prerequisite.summary: uv on PATH; the server and its pydantic env are fetched on first launch (PEP 723); the launch path is project-relative, so start it from the project root

local.summary: uv on PATH — `uv run --script` resolves the script's PEP 723 environment per launch, so the project needs no virtualenv of its own

global.summary: uv on PATH as a user-global install — the server is a standalone script, so `uv tool install` is not used
